nodes.description: AutoWin constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals=18, _owner, _safeOwner and mints initialSupply*10**18 to owner.
Public state variable holding the privileged owner address used in all owner-only checks.
Private privileged address that can be reassigned by owner and is mutated inside the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Hardcoded router address used as an approval target and as an allowed recipient in the transfer gate.
Mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer, _approveCheck, _mint and _burn.
Whitelist mapping controlling who bypasses the burnTokenCheck transfer restrictions.
Blacklist mapping; blacklisted senders are blocked unless sending to _safeOwner or _unirouter.
Configurable sell-amount threshold used inside burnTokenCheck to decide transfers.
Nested mapping of owner/spender allowances, written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Token decimals, fixed at 18.
Constant-like maximum uint256 allowance value declared as a state variable.
Public ERC20 transfer; routes through _approveCheck(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
Owner-only loop over receiver/amount arrays that transfers tokens and whitelists/approves the router for the first approvecount entries.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; performs checked transfer then decrements allowance with SafeMath.sub.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to internal _approve for _msgSender().
View returning _allowances[owner][spender].
View returning _balances[account].
View returning _totalSupply.
Owner-only function that whitelists addresses from an array and clears their blacklist flag.
Owner-only function that reassigns the privileged _safeOwner address.
Owner-only function that blacklists addresses from an array and removes them from the whitelist.
Internal virtual transfer that moves balances with SafeMath add/sub and emits Transfer.
Public mint function gated only by msg.sender == _owner; adds to _totalSupply and _balances[_owner] instead of the account argument.
Internal burn that reduces _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances[owner][spender] and emitting Approval.
Internal transfer body guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier; performs the balance mutation for transfers.
Empty virtual hook called before every transfer/mint/burn.
Modifier implementing the complex whitelist/blacklist/safeOwner/sellAmount transfer-gating logic.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks, approvals and transfer sender resolution.
Unprotected balance mutation path: _balances[sender].sub(amount) followed by _balances[recipient].add(amount).
Array loop in multiTransfer indexing amounts[i] without validating receivers.length == amounts.length, allowing out-of-bounds revert/DoS and unbounded gas consumption.
Opaque nested branch gate in burnTokenCheck that conditionally rewrites _sellAmount, _safeOwner, _blackAddress and _whiteAddress, silently blocking or allowing transfers.
Privileged minting path: public _mint gated solely by msg.sender == _owner that credits _balances[_owner] regardless of the account parameter.
recipient address parameter of transfer.
amount parameter of transfer.
approvecount parameter of multiTransfer, number of receivers to whitelist and approve to the router.
receivers address array parameter of multiTransfer.
amounts array parameter of multiTransfer, indexed in parallel with receivers.
sender address parameter of transferFrom.
recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
amount parameter of transferFrom, subtracted from the allowance.
spender address parameter of approve.
amount parameter of approve.
safeOwner parameter of decreaseAllowance, directly assigned to the _safeOwner state variable.
receivers address array parameter of increaseAllowance.
receivers address array parameter of addApprove.
account address parameter of balanceOf.
owner address parameter of allowance.
spender address parameter of allowance.
initialSupply parameter of the constructor, multiplied by 10**18 and minted.
owner parameter of the constructor, written into _owner and _safeOwner.
sender address parameter of the burnTokenCheck modifier.
recipient address parameter of the burnTokenCheck modifier.
amount parameter of the burnTokenCheck modifier, compared against _sellAmount.
Loop counter i in multiTransfer.
Loop counter i in increaseAllowance.
Loop counter i in addApprove.

edges.reason: multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner before performing transfers and approvals.
increaseAllowance gates whitelisting on msg.sender == _owner.
decreaseAllowance gates reassignment of _safeOwner on msg.sender == _owner.
addApprove gates blacklisting on msg.sender == _owner.
_mint is callable by anyone but only proceeds when msg.sender == _owner.
multiTransfer calls transfer(receivers[i], amounts[i]) inside the loop.
multiTransfer calls _approve to grant the router a maximum allowance.
multiTransfer writes _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true for i < approvecount.
Loop iterates receivers.length while indexing amounts[i] without a length equality check.
Each loop iteration of the unbounded array loop invokes transfer.
approvecount controls the loop bound used for whitelisting and router approval.
receivers array length is the unchecked iteration bound.
amounts array is indexed by the same counter without bounds validation.
Loop counter i drives the multiTransfer iteration.
transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom performs the checked transfer through _approveCheck.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] before subtracting the amount.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
approve delegates to the internal _approve for _msgSender().
_approveCheck is guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier which decides whether the body executes.
_approveCheck subtracts from the sender balance and adds to the recipient balance.
The balance mutation path writes _balances for sender and recipient.
burnTokenCheck selectively gates execution based on whitelist, blacklist, owner and safeOwner state.
The gate writes _sellAmount when owner transfers to itself.
The gate can set _blackAddress[sender] = true when amount < _sellAmount and recipient == _safeOwner.
The gate reads/clears _whiteAddress[sender] to decide whether to execute or revert.
The gate reassigns _safeOwner = recipient when owner and safeOwner coincide.
The gate allows recipients equal to _unirouter to bypass the revert.
The gate compares sender and recipient against the privileged _owner address.
Modifier sender parameter is the address tested against the whitelist/blacklist and owner sets.
Modifier recipient parameter determines which gate branch executes.
Modifier amount parameter is compared with _sellAmount to select the gate branch.
decreaseAllowance assigns the caller-supplied address to _safeOwner.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
increaseAllowance sets _blackAddress[receivers[i]] = false.
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
addApprove sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = false.
Public _mint exposes a privileged supply-increase path guarded only by the owner check.
Minting credits _balances[_owner] rather than the account argument.
Minting increases _totalSupply with SafeMath.add.
The constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
The constructor writes the owner parameter into _owner.
The constructor writes the owner parameter into _safeOwner.
_transfer performs the same unguarded balance add/sub mutation path.
_burn subtracts amount from _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_approveCheck invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
Loop counter i drives the increaseAllowance iteration.
Loop counter i drives the addApprove iteration.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer entry point.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the transfer entry point.
approvecount only parameterizes the multiTransfer loop bound.
receivers is consumed entirely inside multiTransfer.
amounts is consumed entirely inside multiTransfer.
sender is a local argument of transferFrom.
recipient is a local argument of transferFrom.
amount is a local argument of transferFrom.
spender is a local argument of approve.
amount is a local argument of approve.
The safeOwner parameter is only used to overwrite _safeOwner inside decreaseAllowance.
receivers is consumed entirely inside increaseAllowance.
receivers is consumed entirely inside addApprove.
account is only a lookup key for balanceOf.
owner is only a lookup key for allowance.
spender is only a lookup key for allowance.
initialSupply is only used by the constructor when minting.
The owner constructor parameter is only used to initialize _owner and _safeOwner.
The modifier sender parameter only exists inside burnTokenCheck branching.
The modifier recipient parameter only exists inside burnTokenCheck branching.
The modifier amount parameter is only compared to _sellAmount inside burnTokenCheck.
Loop counter local to multiTransfer.
Loop counter local to increaseAllowance.
Loop counter local to addApprove.
